text:
Frederick stared at the swirling ink, the promise of endless years hanging in the balance. The draft intensified, carrying the scent of ozone and old dust. He looked at the vial of shimmering liquid he had just prepared, then back at the book. The runes seemed to pulse, not with power, but with a warning. He realized that eternal life without the wisdom to wield it was merely a curse. With a steady hand, he poured the potion onto the altar stone. It hissed and evaporated into harmless steam, dissolving the final page into ash. He closed the book, leaving the secret buried once more, and walked out of the chamber, lighter than he had ever felt.

Regarding your priority question: The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.
